attributes.name: Barding of Pleated Light
attributes.powers:
When you are dealt damage, recharge this card and reveal a card that has the Animal trait to reduce that damage to 0.

Recharge this card and reveal a card that has the Mount trait to add 1d8 to any check against a bane that has the Undead trait.

If proficient with heavy armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
